Name: Press to Quack
Author: DraconisLeonidas
Description:
Ever wanted to make your farmer quack like a duck?
No?
Well, now you can do it anyway.

This is my first attempt at a mod that does anything in SDV, so yea, it's small and silly, but I'm proud of actually managing to get it done.

What can be done with this mod:
- Quack upon pressing a button any time you're not in a menu (Defaults to Q)
- Change your keybind with the Generic Mod Config Menu
- Multiplayer Compatible, so now your friends can hear you

[s]Planned Updates (No Timeframe):
- Selection of animal sound you can make[/s]

[url=https://github.com/DraconisLeonidas/PressToQuack]Github[/url]

Downloads.Description: Added support for Multiplayer and Generic Mod Config Menu! Now you can easily change the keybind AND annoy your friends.
